slides.sub: Kemistry & Storm — the women inside drum & bass.

text: Just a love for Grooverider's sets
They found Goldie through pirate radio.
He gave them their first turntables.
The label that defined drum & bass —
built by three. Two of them were women.
The Sunday Sessions at the Blue Note, Hoxton.
The first junglists to front the series.
A document of a decade's work.

quote: On the M3 — a passing car dislodged a cat's eye.
Kemistry was in the passenger seat.
slides.note: The only incident of its kind ever recorded on UK roads.

slides.strobe: That's how you know it was real.
